question_en: Which statements are true? 1) $x=A\cos(\omega t+\varphi_0)$ is the equation of harmonic oscillations. 2) The velocity amplitude equals $A\omega$. 3) The total mechanical energy changes with time by a sine law. 4) At resonance the frequency of the external force equals the natural frequency.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) $x=A\cos(\omega t+\varphi_0)$ — garmonik tebranish tenglamasi. 2) Tezlik amplitudasi $A\omega$ ga teng. 3) To'la mexanik energiya vaqt o'tishi bilan sinus qonuni bo'yicha o'zgaradi. 4) Rezonansda tashqi kuch chastotasi xususiy chastotaga teng.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) $x=A\cos(\omega t+\varphi_0)$ — уравнение гармонических колебаний. 2) Амплитуда скорости равна $A\omega$. 3) Полная механическая энергия со временем меняется по закону синуса. 4) При резонансе частота внешней силы равна собственной частоте.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. To'la energiya ishqalanishsiz o'zgarmaydi (3 — noto'g'ri); qolgan uchta fikr to'g'ri.
Asos: E = kA²/2 = const.

en: 3 — false: the energy does not change. $$E=\frac{kA^2}{2}$$

distractors.A: 4-fikr ham to'g'ri: rezonans sharti ν = ν₀

distractors_ru.A: утверждение 4 тоже верно: условие резонанса ν = ν₀

distractors_en.A: statement 4 is also true: the resonance condition is ν = ν₀
distractors_en.C: statement 3 is false and statement 1 is true
distractors_en.D: the total energy is constant, so 3 is false
distractors_en.E: statement 3 is false and statement 2 is true

question_en: An oscillation follows the law $x=0.12\cos(8\pi t+\frac{\pi}{6})\ \mathrm{m}$. Find the period ($\mathrm{s}$).
question_uz: Tebranish $x=0.12\cos(8\pi t+\frac{\pi}{6})\ \mathrm{m}$ qonun bo'yicha ro'y bermoqda. Tebranish davrini toping ($\mathrm{s}$).
question_ru: Колебания происходят по закону $x=0.12\cos(8\pi t+\frac{\pi}{6})\ \mathrm{m}$. Найдите период колебаний ($\mathrm{s}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. ω = 8π rad/s; T = 2π/ω = 2π/(8π) = 0,25 s.
Asos: T = 2π/ω.

distractors.A: davr o'rniga chastota ν = ω/2π topilgan
distractors.B: π oldidagi son chastota deb olingan
distractors.D: π oldidagi son chastota deb olinib, teskarisi olingan

distractors_ru.A: найдена частота ν = ω/2π вместо периода
distractors_ru.B: число перед π принято за частоту
distractors_ru.D: число перед π принято за частоту и обращено

distractors_en.A: the frequency ν = ω/2π was found instead of the period
distractors_en.B: the number in front of π was taken as the frequency
distractors_en.D: the number in front of π was taken as the frequency and inverted
distractors_en.E: the angular frequency ω ≈ 25.1 rad/s was found

question_en: A body oscillates according to $x=0.08\cos3\pi t\ \mathrm{m}$. How far from equilibrium is it at $t=\frac{1}{9}\ \mathrm{s}$ ($\mathrm{cm}$)?
question_uz: Jism $x=0.08\cos3\pi t\ \mathrm{m}$ qonun bo'yicha tebranmoqda. $t=\frac{1}{9}\ \mathrm{s}$ paytda jism muvozanat vaziyatidan qanday masofada bo'ladi ($\mathrm{cm}$)?
question_ru: Тело колеблется по закону $x=0.08\cos3\pi t\ \mathrm{m}$. На каком расстоянии от положения равновесия будет тело в момент $t=\frac{1}{9}\ \mathrm{s}$ ($\mathrm{cm}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Faza 3π · 1/9 = π/3; x = 8 cos(π/3) = 4 cm.
Asos: x = A cos ωt.

distractors.E: faza 2π/3 deb olingan — vaqt ikki marta katta

distractors_en.B: the amplitude was given as the answer
distractors_en.C: sine was used instead of cosine
distractors_en.D: the phase was taken as π/2
distractors_en.E: the phase was taken as 2π/3 — twice the time

question_en: Using the cosine law, write the equation of a harmonic oscillation with an amplitude of $3\ \mathrm{cm}$, making $240$ oscillations per minute, with initial phase $\frac{\pi}{2}$ ($\mathrm{m}$).
question_uz: Amplitudasi $3\ \mathrm{cm}$, minutiga $240$ marta tebranadigan va boshlang'ich fazasi $\frac{\pi}{2}$ bo'lgan garmonik tebranish tenglamasini kosinus qonunida yozing ($\mathrm{m}$).
question_ru: Запишите по закону косинуса уравнение гармонического колебания с амплитудой $3\ \mathrm{cm}$, совершающего $240$ колебаний в минуту, с начальной фазой $\frac{\pi}{2}$ ($\mathrm{m}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. ν = 240/60 = 4 Hz, ω = 2πν = 8π rad/s, A = 0,03 m.
Asos: x = A cos(ωt + φ₀).

distractors.B: ω = πν deb olingan (2 tushib qolgan)
distractors.C: minutdagi tebranishlar soni chastota deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: число колебаний в минуту принято за частоту

distractors_en.A: the amplitude was not converted to metres
distractors_en.B: ω = πν was used (the factor 2 was lost)
distractors_en.C: the number of oscillations per minute was taken as the frequency

question_en: A $0.1\ \mathrm{kg}$ load on a spring of stiffness $250\ \mathrm{N/m}$ is pulled $4\ \mathrm{cm}$ from equilibrium and released. Find the law of oscillation ($\mathrm{m}$).
question_uz: Bikrligi $250\ \mathrm{N/m}$ bo'lgan prujinaga osilgan $0.1\ \mathrm{kg}$ yuk muvozanatdan $4\ \mathrm{cm}$ ga tortilib qo'yib yuborildi. Tebranish qonunini toping ($\mathrm{m}$).
question_ru: Груз $0.1\ \mathrm{kg}$ на пружине жёсткостью $250\ \mathrm{N/m}$ оттянули от равновесия на $4\ \mathrm{cm}$ и отпустили. Найдите закон колебаний ($\mathrm{m}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. ω = √(k/m) = √(250/0,1) = 50 rad/s; chetdan qo'yib yuborilgan — kosinus: x = 0,04 cos 50t.
Asos: ω = √(k/m).

distractors_en.A: centimetres were converted to metres incorrectly
distractors_en.B: the square root was not taken
distractors_en.D: the amplitude was not converted to metres

question_en: The period of a pendulum is $6\ \mathrm{s}$. How long does it take to move from equilibrium to half the amplitude ($\mathrm{s}$)?
question_uz: Mayatnikning tebranish davri $6\ \mathrm{s}$. U muvozanat vaziyatidan yarim amplitudagacha qancha vaqtda siljiydi ($\mathrm{s}$)?
question_ru: Период колебаний маятника $6\ \mathrm{s}$. За какое время он сместится от положения равновесия до половины амплитуды ($\mathrm{s}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Radius π/6 ga buriladi: t = T/12 = 6/12 = 0,5 s.
Asos: muvozanatdan A/2 gacha T/12.

distractors.C: A/2 dan chetgacha vaqt T/6 topilgan

distractors_ru.C: найдено время от A/2 до края T/6
distractors_ru.E: взято время до A/√2, т.е. T/8

distractors_en.C: the time from A/2 to the extreme T/6 was found

question_en: A body oscillates according to $x=0.4\sin5t\ \mathrm{m}$. Find its maximum speed ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
question_uz: Jism $x=0.4\sin5t\ \mathrm{m}$ qonun bo'yicha tebranmoqda. Uning maksimal tezligini toping ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
question_ru: Тело колеблется по закону $x=0.4\sin5t\ \mathrm{m}$. Найдите его максимальную скорость ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. v(max) = Aω = 0,4 · 5 = 2 m/s.
Asos: v(max) = Aω.

distractors_en.A: the amplitude was given as the answer
distractors_en.B: the acceleration amplitude Aω² was found

question_en: The equation of harmonic oscillations is $x=0.05\cos4\pi t\ \mathrm{m}$. Find the magnitude of the maximum acceleration ($\mathrm{m/s^2}$).
question_uz: Garmonik tebranish tenglamasi $x=0.05\cos4\pi t\ \mathrm{m}$. Tebranishdagi maksimal tezlanish modulini toping ($\mathrm{m/s^2}$).
question_ru: Уравнение гармонических колебаний $x=0.05\cos4\pi t\ \mathrm{m}$. Найдите модуль максимального ускорения ($\mathrm{m/s^2}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. a(max) = Aω² = 0,05 · (4π)² = 0,8π² m/s².
Asos: a(max) = Aω².

distractors_en.A: the velocity amplitude Aω was found
distractors_en.C: ω was taken twice as large: 8π
distractors_en.E: it was not multiplied by the amplitude

question_en: Two point masses oscillate according to $x_1=0.2\sin(\pi t+3\pi)$ and $x_2=0.2\sin(2\pi t-\pi)$ ($\mathrm{m}$). After what time do their phases become equal ($\mathrm{s}$)?
question_uz: Ikki moddiy nuqta $x_1=0.2\sin(\pi t+3\pi)$ va $x_2=0.2\sin(2\pi t-\pi)$ qonunlar bo'yicha tebranmoqda ($\mathrm{m}$). Qancha vaqtdan keyin ularning fazalari tenglashadi ($\mathrm{s}$)?
question_ru: Две материальные точки колеблются по законам $x_1=0.2\sin(\pi t+3\pi)$ и $x_2=0.2\sin(2\pi t-\pi)$ ($\mathrm{m}$). Через какое время их фазы станут равны ($\mathrm{s}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Fazalar tengligi: πt + 3π = 2πt − π, bundan πt = 4π, t = 4 s.
Asos: φ = ωt + φ₀.

en: Set the phases equal: $$\pi t+3\pi=2\pi t-\pi$$

question_en: The amplitude of a harmonic oscillation is increased $2$ times and the frequency $3$ times. By what factor does the total energy increase?
question_uz: Garmonik tebranish amplitudasi $2$ marta, chastotasi $3$ marta orttirildi. To'la energiya necha marta ortadi?
question_ru: Амплитуду гармонического колебания увеличили в $2$ раза, частоту — в $3$ раза. Во сколько раз увеличится полная энергия?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. E ~ ν²A²: (2²) · (3²) = 4 · 9 = 36.
Asos: E = mω²A²/2.

uz: Energiya chastota va amplituda kvadratiga proporsional: $$E=2\pi^2m\nu^2A^2$$
ru: Энергия пропорциональна квадратам частоты и амплитуды: $$E=2\pi^2m\nu^2A^2$$
en: The energy is proportional to the squares of frequency and amplitude: $$E=2\pi^2m\nu^2A^2$$

distractors_en.E: the change in amplitude was ignored

question_en: The length of a simple pendulum is increased $4$ times and the amplitude $6$ times. By what factor does its total mechanical energy increase?
question_uz: Matematik mayatnikning uzunligi $4$ marta, tebranish amplitudasi $6$ marta orttirildi. Uning to'la mexanik energiyasi necha marta ortadi?
question_ru: Длину математического маятника увеличили в $4$ раза, амплитуду колебаний — в $6$ раз. Во сколько раз увеличится его полная механическая энергия?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. E = mgA²/(2l): A² 36 marta ortadi, l 4 marta ortadi: 36/4 = 9.
Asos: E = mgA²/(2l).

distractors_en.B: it was multiplied by the length instead of divided
distractors_en.D: only the amplitude was used, without squaring
distractors_en.E: the change in length was ignored

question_en: A spring pendulum oscillates with an amplitude of $6\ \mathrm{cm}$. At what distance from equilibrium is its kinetic energy equal to its potential energy ($\mathrm{cm}$)?
question_uz: Prujinali mayatnik $6\ \mathrm{cm}$ amplituda bilan tebranmoqda. Muvozanat vaziyatidan qanday masofada uning kinetik energiyasi potensial energiyasiga teng bo'ladi ($\mathrm{cm}$)?
question_ru: Пружинный маятник колеблется с амплитудой $6\ \mathrm{cm}$. На каком расстоянии от положения равновесия его кинетическая энергия равна потенциальной ($\mathrm{cm}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Eₖ = Eₚ bo'lsa Eₚ = E/2: kx²/2 = kA²/4, x = A/√2 = 6/√2 = 3√2 ≈ 4,24 cm.
Asos: Eₚ = kx²/2.

distractors.A: energiya teng bo'lsa siljish ham A/2 deb olingan
distractors.E: x = A/(2√2) — Eₚ = E/8 holati olingan

distractors_ru.A: принято, что при равных энергиях смещение A/2
distractors_ru.E: взято x = A/(2√2) — случай Eₚ = E/8

distractors_en.A: equal energies were assumed to mean a displacement of A/2
distractors_en.B: the amplitude was given as the answer
distractors_en.E: x = A/(2√2) was taken — the case Eₚ = E/8

question_en: When a car with wheels of radius $0.4\ \mathrm{m}$ passed a house, a window pane with a natural frequency of $6\ \mathrm{Hz}$ rattled because of resonance. Find the speed of the car ($\mathrm{m/s}$, $\pi=3$).
question_uz: Uy oldidan g'ildiragi radiusi $0.4\ \mathrm{m}$ bo'lgan mashina o'tganda, xususiy chastotasi $6\ \mathrm{Hz}$ bo'lgan deraza oynasi rezonans tufayli zirillab ketdi. Mashina tezligini toping ($\mathrm{m/s}$, $\pi=3$).
question_ru: Когда мимо дома проезжала машина с колёсами радиусом $0.4\ \mathrm{m}$, оконное стекло с собственной частотой $6\ \mathrm{Hz}$ задребезжало из-за резонанса. Найдите скорость машины ($\mathrm{m/s}$, $\pi=3$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Rezonansda g'ildirak aylanish chastotasi 6 Hz: v = 2πRν = 2 · 3 · 0,4 · 6 = 14,4 m/s.
Asos: ν = v/(2πR) = ν₀.

distractors_ru.D: вместо умножения на частоту выполнено деление

distractors_en.A: the radius was used instead of the circumference
distractors_en.B: the diameter was used instead of the radius
distractors_en.C: the circumference was taken as πR
distractors_en.D: it was divided by the frequency instead of multiplied
